title: Evaluation of an individual middle gate
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, let $x$ be a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates, and let $i$ index a clause in the middle layer. The OR gate on the inputs specified for clause $i$, fed by the corresponding first-layer AND outputs, has the same value as that clause evaluated on the length-$m$ sign pattern whose entry at block $b$ is the parity sign of the two-block restriction of $x$ selected for $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates
$i$ indexes an element of the middle-layer list
